en.headline: HKPAX stages two public ticketed shows today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo presents Paradisum and An Isolated Case this afternoon at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, with tickets still available on URBTIX.

zh.headline: 香港演藝博覽今於東九文化中心呈獻兩場公眾售票演出
zh.dek: 香港演藝博覽今天下午於東九文化中心上演《天境重生》及《純屬個別事件》，門票現於城市售票網發售。

en.headline: Two cars collide on North Lantau Highway near Siu Ho Wan; four injured
en.dek: Two private cars crashed while heading towards the airport at about 7:03am on Sunday, with one vehicle overturning; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山公路近小蠔灣兩車相撞 一人翻側四傷
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時03分，兩輛私家車沿北大嶼山公路往機場方向行駛至近小蠔灣時相撞，其中一輛翻側，警方正調查。

en.headline: Planter fire at Tseung Kwan O PopCorn mall extinguished, no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a planter on the platform of the PopCorn mall in Tseung Kwan O late Saturday night; no one was hurt and no evacuation was needed.

zh.headline: 將軍澳PopCorn商場平台花槽起火 消防撲熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚上約11時31分，將軍澳唐賢街PopCorn商場平台花槽起火，消防將火救熄，無人受傷，毋須疏散。

en.headline: AFCD Leisure Nature Chill Fun Expo continues today in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: The free two-day event at East Point City runs from noon to 7pm, featuring exhibitions, workshops and sales of local agricultural and fisheries products.

zh.headline: 漁護署「漁農自然Chill好玩」博覽今續於將軍澳
zh.dek: 免費兩日活動於東港城1樓中庭中午至晚上7時舉行，設展覽、工作坊及本地農漁業產品銷售。

en.headline: Man in 20s attacked with knives at Tsuen Wan bar, suspects flee
en.dek: Police are investigating after a man in his twenties was stabbed in the head and hand at a bar on Sha Tsui Road in the early hours of Sunday.

zh.headline: 荃灣酒吧男子遭持刀襲擊 頭手受傷清醒送院
zh.dek: 警方調查周日凌晨約2時22分，一名20多歲男子在沙咀道酒吧遭兩至三名男子持刀襲擊，頭部及手部受傷。

en.headline: Observatory raises yellow fire danger warning at 6am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the yellow fire danger warning at 6:00 a.m., indicating a high fire risk, and reminded the public to take extra precautions.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨6時發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，提醒市民特別提高警覺並採取適當防火措施。

en.headline: Sundays By the Bay launches today at Pui O for Treasure Island's 30th
en.dek: The free monthly gathering at Treasure Island Campsite runs from noon to 6pm with live music, local makers and activities open to families and dogs.

zh.headline: 貝澳Treasure Island海灣週日今首辦 慶祝30週年
zh.dek: 免費活動由中午12時至下午6時於貝澳營地舉行，設現場音樂、本地手作及社區活動，歡迎一家大小及寵物狗參與。

en.headline: Anita Mui fan club says ashes urn missing from Po Lin Monastery since July
en.dek: On the late singer’s 63rd birthday the International Fan Club issued a statement that a fan found the niche empty on 18 July; police have been investigating for nearly three months.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳歌迷會指骨灰甕7月起在寶蓮禪寺失蹤
zh.dek: 周六為已故天后63歲冥壽，國際歌迷會發聲明稱7月18日歌迷發現海會塔靈位螺絲鬆脫、骨灰甕不翼而飛，報警近三個月仍未尋回。

en.headline: Cyclothon Carnival runs today at West Kowloon Art Park
en.dek: The free event at the Great Lawn accompanies the Hong Kong Cyclothon rides and races, with sports activities, food stalls and live performances from 6.30am to 6pm.

zh.headline: 單車節嘉年華今於西九藝術公園草地舉行
zh.dek: 活動由早上6時30分至下午6時免費入場，設運動市集、美食檔及互動體驗，配合香港單車節賽事。

en.headline: Mercedes catches fire on Tsing Sha Highway; driver and passenger escape unhurt
en.dek: A 1995 Mercedes S320 erupted in flames near Container Terminal 8 on Saturday night; firefighters raised the incident to a No. 2 alarm before extinguishing the blaze.

zh.headline: 青沙公路平治起火 司機乘客棄車逃生無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚上約10時40分，一輊1995年平治S320在昂船洲大橋近八號貨櫃碼頭車頭冒煙起火，消防列作二級火警後將火救熄。

en.headline: Youth arrests rise 23 per cent in first eight months, police chief says
en.dek: Commissioner Joe Chow disclosed the figure while officiating a civic education ceremony, linking most cases to impulsive assaults, fraud involving bank accounts, and damage tied to debt collection.

zh.headline: 首八月逾2100名青少年被捕按年升23% 周一鳴：加強防罪宣傳
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴在學界公民教育專員畢業禮上披露數據，指主要涉及傷人毆打、詐騙洗黑錢及與非法收債有關的刑事毀壞。

en.headline: Mark Six jackpot goes unclaimed in Saturday draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club draw returned numbers 12, 14, 20, 33, 34 and 37 with special number 31, leaving the first prize unwon and the next fund estimated at HK$28 million.

zh.headline: 周六六合彩頭獎無人中 下期基金估2800萬
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會周六攪珠，中獎號碼為12、14、20、33、34、37，特別號碼31，頭獎無人中，下期估計頭獎基金達2800萬港元。

en.headline: Civil service chief will not rule out discipline if Tai Po fire report names officials
en.dek: Secretary Ingrid Yeung said a support unit is being prepared for the Public Service Commission, and direct disciplinary action remains possible if the independent panel identifies individual failings.

zh.headline: 公務員事務局長：宏福苑報告若點名不排除直接紀律處分
zh.dek: 楊何蓓茵表示已準備支援小組協助公務員敍用委員會，若獨立委員會報告清晰指出個別公務員失職，不排除直接啟動紀律程序。

en.headline: Police arrest 127 in operation against Vietnamese-led loan-sharking syndicate
en.dek: Officers seized more than HK$2 million after a six-month undercover probe into a group that charged daily interest of HK$100 per HK$10,000 and ran illegal gambling and bars in West Kowloon.

zh.headline: 警破深水埗越南裔高利貸集團 拘127人年利率達3700厘
zh.dek: 有組織罪案科經半年臥底調查後，於8日至9日行動拘捕127人，檢獲逾200萬元得益，集團以同鄉會掩飾向同鄉放貴利並經營非法賭檔及酒吧。

en.headline: Election Committee nominations reach 756 candidate forms
en.dek: Returning officers received 71 more candidate nomination forms and one from a designated body on Saturday, the fourth day of the two-week nomination window.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉再接72份提名 累計756份候選人表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任周六接獲71份候選人提名表格及1份指定團體提名表格，提名期第四日，累計候選人提名表格達756份。

en.headline: Departments detail switchover plans for new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Immigration, Customs, Transport and Police set out clearance, transport and crowd arrangements for the 6.30am opening on Monday, when Lok Ma Chau services end.

zh.headline: 多部門公布新皇崗口岸周一轉換安排
zh.dek: 入境處、海關、運輸署及警務處詳列周一早上6時30分開通的清關、交通及人流安排，落馬洲服務屆時暫停。

en.headline: Firefighters and SPCA rescue three kittens from Yau Ma Tei courtyard
en.dek: The young cats, estimated at two to three months old, were freed from a vacant shop's light well on Shanghai Street after a cat volunteer reported faint meowing around midday.

zh.headline: 油麻地上海街天井三幼貓獲救 消防愛協合力破門
zh.dek: 中午時分貓義工報稱空置地舖傳出微弱貓聲，消防破門後與愛協救出約兩至三個月大幼貓，交義工照料。

en.headline: Immigration Department arrests 20 in week-long anti-illegal worker operations
en.dek: Officers detained 17 suspected illegal workers, two employers and one overstayer after raids on restaurants, renovation sites and beauty salons from 2 to 8 October.

zh.headline: 入境處一連七日反黑工行動拘捕20人
zh.dek: 入境事務處聯同警方等多個部門於10月2日至8日行動，在餐廳、裝修單位及美容院等處所拘捕17名懷疑非法勞工、兩名僱主及一名逾期逗留者。

en.headline: Police arrest 16 in operation against Tsim Sha Tsui prostitution syndicate
en.dek: West Kowloon officers seized more than HK$13 million in cash and froze over HK$5 million after targeting a group that arranged Thai women for hotel sex work and took a large share of the earnings.

zh.headline: 警破尖沙咀跨國賣淫集團 拘16人檢逾1300萬
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組於8日至9日行動，搞破招攭泰國女子在酒店賣淫並抽取大部分收益的集團，檢獲逾1300萬港元現金並凍結逾500萬港元。

en.headline: Mak outlines three-tier mechanism for building renovation disputes
en.dek: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said the planned system would involve district councillors first, then professional mediation, and finally the courts, with a target launch next year.

zh.headline: 麥美娟：明年推三層機制處理大廈管理糾紛
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟表示，計劃明年推行三層調解機制，先由區議員介入，再轉介專業調解，最終才交法庭處理，以改善包括大維修在內的大廈管理。

en.headline: Guangdong yachts to make first southbound voyage on 16 October
en.dek: The Transport and Logistics Bureau and Marine Department will hold a first-voyage ceremony next Friday to welcome the initial batch of Guangdong-registered yachts under the new reciprocal arrangement.

zh.headline: 「粵艇南下」首航儀式定於10月16日舉行
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，運輸及物流局與海事處將於下周五舉行「粵艇南下」首航儀式，迎接首批廣東遊艇來港。

en.headline: Department of Health runs Mental Recharge Station through Sunday
en.dek: The free event at MOSTown in Ma On Shan continues until Sunday evening to mark World Mental Health Day, with interactive games, workshops and a focus on listening to lived experience.

zh.headline: 衞生署「心靈補給站」馬鞍山展至周日
zh.dek: 為響應世界精神衞生日，衞生署在馬鞍山新港城中心舉辦免費活動，由周五起至周日傍晚，設互動遊戲及工作坊，強調聆聽親身經歷。

en.headline: Environment chief outlines 24-hour smart recycling and clean energy goals
en.dek: Secretary Tse Chin-wan said the government will expand community recycling with round-the-clock automated points and aims to raise the share of zero-carbon energy to 60 to 70 per cent by 2035.

zh.headline: 環境局長：推24小時智能回收 目標2035年零碳電力達六至七成
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，政府將加強社區回收網絡，包括推出24小時智能回收桶，並有信心達至2035年零碳能源佔比六至七成的目標。

en.headline: Red flags hoisted at five beaches due to big waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department says swimmers should stay out of the water at Stanley Main, Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second Beach.

zh.headline: 五個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示，赤柱正灘、石澳、大浪灣、銀線灣及清水灣第二灣因大浪懸掛紅旗，市民請勿游泳。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new Mpox case
en.dek: A 29-year-old man tested positive after developing symptoms, bringing this year's total to 30 cases as authorities step up vaccination and contact tracing.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新增猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 一名29歲男子出現病徵後確診，今年累計30宗個案，中心加強疫苗接種及接觸者追蹤。

en.headline: Observatory expects fine and dry weather for the weekend
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory says Saturday and Sunday will be mainly fine and dry, with daytime highs around 31 degrees under moderate east to northeasterly winds.

zh.headline: 天文台預測周末大致天晴乾燥
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，周六及周日大致天晴及日間乾燥，市區最高氣溫約31度，吹和緩東至東北風。

en.headline: Police set phased Chung Yeung traffic controls from today
en.dek: Special arrangements run in multiple districts until early November to manage grave-sweeping traffic near cemeteries and columbaria.

zh.headline: 警方分階段實施重陽節特別交通安排
zh.dek: 多區由周四起至11月上旬實施封路、禁區及停車限制，以便利掃墓及維持交通暢順。

en.headline: Ciao Gelato Fest continues at PMQ through Sunday
en.dek: PMQ lists the Italian-style gelato market running from noon to 10pm on Saturday and Sunday at the ground-floor courtyard, with free entry.

zh.headline: 元創方Ciao意式雪糕市集展至周日
zh.dek: 元創方活動頁列出，意式雪糕市集周六及周日中午12時至晚上10時於地面廣場舉行，入場免費。

en.headline: Free rare-animal exhibition opens at The Mills for Halloween
en.dek: The Mills says the Tales of the Crawlers show at Building 6 ground floor runs from Saturday to 1 November and includes species making their first public appearance in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠免費怪奇動物展覽今日開幕
zh.dek: 南豐紗廠與香港昆蟲教育及科普中心合作，六廠地下「奇蟲物語」展覽由周六起至11月1日，部分物種首次在港公開展出。

en.headline: Helicopter airlifts hiker from Lion Rock after morning illness
en.dek: Police said a woman reported that her 17-year-old daughter and two friends were on Lion Rock when one began vomiting and feeling cold.

zh.headline: 獅子山行山人士清晨不適 直升機送院
zh.dek: 警方接報指一名17歲少女與兩名友人登獅子山時，其中一人嘔吐及發冷。

en.headline: Elderly woman recovers after suspected choking in Yuen Long home
en.dek: Rescuers found the 87-year-old still breathing but unconscious after a report of a choking incident at about 5am in a Tai Hang Street unit.

zh.headline: 元朗院舍八旬婦疑鯁喉昏迷 送院後恢復清醒
zh.dek: 清晨約5時泰衡街大興大廈院舍單位內一名87歲老婦進食時疑鯁喉，仍有呼吸脈搏但陷入昏迷，其後清醒。

en.headline: Cyclothon closures begin at Mody Road from noon
en.dek: The Transport Department says a loading area and a slow lane off Mody Road close from Saturday noon, with wider closures from 1am on Sunday.

zh.headline: 單車節封路周六中午由麼地道開始
zh.dek: 運輸署公布周日香港單車節特別交通安排，麼地道上落客貨區及慢線周六中午起封閉，主要封路則由周日凌晨1時展開。

en.headline: Moonlit Bunny lights stay at Cultural Centre until Sunday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department says the STICKYLINE installation at the Cultural Centre Piazza is lit from 6:30pm to 11pm and runs until Sunday.

zh.headline: 文化中心「月下兔仔團」燈飾展至周日
zh.dek: 康文署表示，本地團隊STICKYLINE的燈飾裝置置於文化中心廣場，每日傍晚6時半至晚上11時亮燈，展期至周日。

en.headline: Man, 57, found dead at Ping Tin Estate, reports say
en.dek: Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao reported that staff found a man unconscious in a service building at about 9pm on Friday, and paramedics confirmed he had died.

zh.headline: 藍田平田邨服務大樓揭57歲男子死亡
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島報道，周五晚約9時職員發現男子在服務設施大樓房間內暈倒，救護員到場證實不治。

en.headline: Observatory raises yellow fire danger warning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 6am on Saturday, saying the fire risk is fairly high.

zh.headline: 天文台上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 香港天文台周六上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，呼籲市民提高警覺。

en.headline: Candlelight string concerts return to PMQ this weekend
en.dek: PMQ lists two Fever concerts on Saturday and Sunday at the Qube, with sittings at 5pm and 7pm and tickets from 130 dollars.

zh.headline: 燭光弦樂音樂會今個周末再於元創方演出
zh.dek: 元創方活動頁列出周六及周日於Qube舉行兩場，下午5時及7時開場，票價由130元起。

en.headline: Three Tuen Mun Road crashes injure at least eight
en.dek: Police logged three collisions in about 20 minutes on Friday evening near Siu Hong, and queues toward Yuen Long stretched past 10 kilometres.

zh.headline: 屯門公路傍晚三宗車禍 最少八人受傷
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島報道，周五傍晚約20分鐘內兆康一帶接連三宗交通意外，往元朗車龍一度逾10公里。

en.headline: Man, 46, found dead in a Yau Ma Tei room, police say
en.dek: Officers classified the Friday night case as the discovery of a body after a friend reported that the man had collapsed, Hong Kong 01 reported.

zh.headline: 油麻地46歲男子房間內暈倒 當場不治
zh.dek: 《香港01》報道，警方周五晚接報後將案件列作屍體發現，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Adora Flora City to sail 19 Hong Kong home-port trips in 2027
en.dek: The cruise line said the ship will use Hong Kong as a home port for 19 sailings next year, after a November call and a New Year overnight voyage.

zh.headline: 愛達·花城號明年以香港為母港 營運19個航次
zh.dek: 愛達郵輪周五公佈，花城號明年將以香港為母港開出19個航次，並於十一月首航後到訪香港。

en.headline: KMB to open three routes to Huanggang Port on Monday
en.dek: Services from Kwai Fong, Tin Shui Wai and Sha Tin start when the rebuilt port opens, with an interchange concession on more than 100 routes.

zh.headline: 九巴下周一開辦三條新皇崗口岸路線
zh.dek: 葵芳、天水圍及沙田線隨口岸開通同日投入服務，並與逾百條路線提供搭兩程、俾一程優惠。

en.headline: West Kowloon picnic festival runs its final weekend
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District lists the picnic festival through Sunday, closing a run that began in mid-September.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節進入最後週末 周日結束
zh.dek: 西九文化區網頁列出野餐節由九月中開至周日，今個週末是節期最後兩天。

en.headline: Election Committee takes 225 more forms on third day
en.dek: Returning officers received 220 candidate forms and five designated-body forms on Friday, taking the candidate total to 685.

zh.headline: 選委會提名第三日再接225份表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任周五接獲220份候選人提名表格及5份指定團體提名表格，候選人提名累計685份。

en.headline: LegCo condemns European Parliament remarks on Hong Kong
en.dek: A Legislative Council spokesman said a recommendation on EU-China relations made untrue allegations about the city and urged the parliament to stop.

zh.headline: 立法會譴責歐洲議會有關香港的說法
zh.dek: 立法會發言人指歐中政治關係建議在香港部分作出失實偏頗指控，促請歐洲議會立即停止。

en.headline: Centre tells shops to pull two Marks and Spencer foods
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety says a salad and a pesto may be contaminated with salmonella, and the importer has begun a recall.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用兩款馬莎沙律及青醬
zh.dek: 食物安全中心指一款沙律及一款青醬或受沙門氏菌污染，進口商已停售並展開回收。

en.headline: One Stanley developer offers six-year structural cover
en.dek: K Wise says owners and buyers still completing purchases will get extra structural cover and free independent checks while a steel-bar probe continues.

zh.headline: 赤柱ONE STANLEY發展商提供額外六年結構保養
zh.dek: 建灝旗下公司表示，已成交業主及交易中買家可獲額外六年結構保養及免費獨立檢測，屋宇署調查仍在進行。

en.headline: Mak says three-tier building-dispute system will start next year
en.dek: The home affairs chief told lawmakers a three-tier system, with early district-councillor involvement and professional mediation, is planned for next year.

zh.headline: 麥美娟：明年推大廈管理糾紛三層機制
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長表示，明年會推出三層機制，由區議員及早介入並配合專業調解，處理大廈管理糾紛。

en.headline: Government aims to table building and fire law changes by year end
en.dek: Officials told lawmakers they plan to widen building-law amendments and revise the Fire Services Ordinance, with drafts targeted before the end of the year.

zh.headline: 政府目標年底提交建築物及消防條例修訂
zh.dek: 發展局及保安局向立法會表示，將擴大建築物條例修訂範圍，並修訂消防條例，目標今年底提交建議。

en.headline: Civil service appraisal overhaul begins for 100 grades
en.dek: The Civil Service Bureau said the first phase covers 100 grades in appraisal cycles starting on or after 1 October, with a review after two cycles.

zh.headline: 公務員評核優化首期涵蓋100個職階
zh.dek: 公務員事務局表示，評核制度優化計劃第一期涵蓋100個職階，適用於10月1日或之後開始的評核周期，兩個周期後檢討。

en.headline: Lawmakers pass thanks motion on five-year plan and policy address
en.dek: After three days of debate, the Legislative Council passed the thanks motion on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address.

zh.headline: 立法會通過五年規劃及施政報告致謝議案
zh.dek: 立法會經過一連三日辯論，周五晚上通過香港第一個五年規劃及施政報告的致謝議案。

en.headline: Orient Overseas says third-quarter line revenue rose 45 per cent
en.dek: The carrier reported line revenue of 3.285 billion US dollars for the quarter, with the Pacific trade up nearly 72 per cent, RTHK said.

zh.headline: 東方海外第三季航線收入按年升45%
zh.dek: 公司第三季航線收入32.85億美元，太平洋航線升近72%至約14.4億美元，為最大收入來源。

en.headline: Man charged over alleged false statement to competition watchdog
en.dek: The Competition Commission said the Eastern Magistrates case is the first criminal prosecution for giving it false or misleading information.

zh.headline: 男子被控向競委會提供虛假或誤導資料
zh.dek: 競委會稱，案件周五在東區裁判法院提堂，是首宗因向該會提供虛假或具誤導性資料而提出的刑事檢控。

en.headline: Sun says Fu Tai siblings will not go straight home
en.dek: The welfare secretary said social workers judge the three children should go to temporary residential care after hospital checks.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡：富泰三姊弟出院後暫不回家
zh.dek: 勞福局局長表示，社署評估三名兒童現階段不宜即時回家，出院後會安排入住臨時住宿。

en.headline: More than 160,000 sign up for Huanggang joint clearance
en.dek: Immigration officials said the mobile-app enrolments were completed by Friday noon, three days after registration opened.

zh.headline: 逾16萬人已登記皇崗協作查驗自助通道
zh.dek: 入境處表示，截至周五中午，市民經流動應用程式完成登記的人數已超過16萬，登記開放約三日。

en.headline: Centre reports imported chikungunya and dengue cases
en.dek: A 73-year-old man who had been on the mainland has recovered from chikungunya, and a separate dengue case was linked to travel in Vietnam.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心公布輸入基孔肯雅熱及登革熱個案
zh.dek: 一名曾往內地的73歲男子感染基孔肯雅熱後已康復出院，另一宗登革熱個案的病人潛伏期內曾到越南。

en.headline: All 400 Victoria Park fair stalls let for about 8.65 million
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said the three-day auction for the 2027 Lunar New Year fair drew about 1,320 attendances.

zh.headline: 維園年宵400個攤位全部租出 收入約865萬元
zh.dek: 食環署表示，2027年維園年宵市場一連三日公開競投周五結束，共吸引約1320人次進場。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes 426 points higher at 24,211
en.dek: The index finished Friday up 1.79 per cent, extending the midday gain, with turnover at about 209.2 billion dollars.

zh.headline: 恒指收市升426點 重上24211點
zh.dek: 恒生指數周五收報24211點，升425點或1.79%，成交約2092億元，科指升逾3%。

en.headline: Compulsory cover extended to Hong Kong side of Huanggang Port
en.dek: The government said 45 insurers have agreed, at no extra premium, to extend motor and employees' compensation policies to the Hong Kong port area.

zh.headline: 強制汽車及僱員補償保險擴至皇崗港方口岸區
zh.dek: 政府稱已與45間保險公司簽訂市場協議，現有強制性保單毋須加費即可覆蓋皇崗口岸港方口岸區。

en.headline: Lo says work on a New Territories North hospital cluster starts next year
en.dek: The health secretary told LegCo the Hospital Authority would begin preparing a New Territories North cluster in 2027 to match Northern Metropolis growth.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：明年起籌建新界北醫院聯網
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長表示，為配合北部都會區，明年起會開展籌建新界北聯網，並評估洪水橋醫院的需要。

en.headline: Housing Bureau logs over 74,300 subdivided-unit registrations
en.dek: Winnie Ho told lawmakers the basic-housing scheme has drawn more than 74,300 applications about six months after it began.

zh.headline: 房屋局已收逾7.43萬個分間單位登記申請
zh.dek: 何永賢在立法會表示，簡樸房制度推行約半年多，已收到超過7.43萬個分間單位登記申請。

en.headline: Government proposes a new Wo Hop Shek crematorium for 2032
en.dek: A paper to LegCo puts the cost at about 2.03 billion dollars and says the site would add about 21,600 cremation sessions a year.

zh.headline: 政府建議和合石建新火葬場 預計2032年啟用
zh.dek: 立法會文件初步估算工程費用約20.3億元，新場設10個火化爐，每年可多提供約2.16萬節時段。

en.headline: Competition watchdog searches 11 sites over school VR bids
en.dek: The Competition Commission said Thursday's Lens operation targeted alleged bid-rigging on virtual-reality contracts worth about 10 million dollars.

zh.headline: 競委會「銳鏡」行動搜查11處所 涉學校VR報價圍標
zh.dek: 競委會周五公布，周四持法庭手令搜查資訊科技供應商辦公室及住所，涉案合約約1000萬元。

en.headline: Housing Society warns of fake Fanling AI receptionist site
en.dek: The association said a site posing as an artificial-intelligence receptionist for its Pak Wo Road project has been passed to police.

zh.headline: 房協揭偽冒粉嶺百和路人工智能接待員網站
zh.dek: 房協指騙徒以人工智能客服誘套個人資料，已將案件交警方，並呼籲市民勿登入可疑網站。

en.headline: Last Huanggang shuttle leaves San Tin before Monday opening
en.dek: Transport officials said the final shuttle from San Tin is due between 6:15am and 6:20am on 12 October, with buses covering the rebuilt port.

zh.headline: 皇巴尾班周一6時15分開出 巴士接載往新皇崗
zh.dek: 運輸署稱新田開出的皇巴尾班在6時15至20分，趕不及的乘客可轉乘B11、B12、B13及三條專線小巴。

en.headline: Hang Seng rises 259 points at the Friday midday close
en.dek: The benchmark regained the 24,000 mark by lunchtime, up 1.1 per cent, after Thursday's three-month low.

zh.headline: 恒指半日升259點 重上24000點
zh.dek: 經濟通報道，恒生指數午市收報24045點，升1.1%，科技指數升1.5%。

en.headline: Huanggang Port to open at 6:30am on Monday
en.dek: Hong Kong and Shenzhen said the rebuilt crossing will start 24-hour passenger clearance on 12 October, ending the temporary Lok Ma Chau link.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸周一早上6時半正式開通
zh.dek: 港深公布新口岸周一提供24小時客運通關，同時暫停臨時旅檢樓與落馬洲管制站的旅客清關。

en.headline: SFC says HKEX will consult this quarter on longer cash hours
en.dek: Julia Leung said longer trading would start in derivatives, with a cash-market discussion paper due in the fourth quarter.

zh.headline: 證監會：港交所今季就延長現貨時段發討論文件
zh.dek: 梁鳳儀在亞洲證券業論壇稱，延長交易時段會先在衍生產品市場推行，現貨市場文件於第四季發表。

en.headline: Observatory expects a fine, dry weekend with highs near 31
en.dek: Saturday and Sunday should stay fine and dry under an east to northeast breeze, with temperatures between 26 and 31 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台料周末天晴乾燥 最高氣溫約31度
zh.dek: 周六及周日預料天晴、日間乾燥，吹東至東北風4級，氣溫約26至31度。

en.headline: ICAC charges Greentown's then chairman over alleged bribe
en.dek: Zhang Yadong, 58, appeared at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Friday over a 20 million dollar payment tied to a Dalian deal.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴綠城中國時任主席張亞東涉收賄2000萬
zh.dek: 58歲張亞東周五在東區裁判法院提訊，被控串謀使代理人接受利益，涉一宗大連項目。

en.headline: Lawmakers press childcare and North District shops in debate
en.dek: The third day of the joint five-year plan and Policy Address debate turned to livelihood, with calls on childcare and vacant shops.

zh.headline: 立法會辯論民生 陳曼琪倡一老一小保護 姚銘談北區舖位
zh.dek: 五年規劃與施政報告合併辯論第三日轉到民生環節，議員談託兒名額、虐老舉報及北區空舖。

en.headline: Police charge man, 52, over alleged seditious online posts
en.dek: National security officers said the Eastern District arrest was in July, with a charge laid on Wednesday at West Kowloon Court.

zh.headline: 國安處控52歲男子涉發布具煽動意圖刊物
zh.dek: 警方稱男子7月9日在東區被捕，10月7日被控一項罪名，同日下午在西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Hip Shing Hong sells Central shop held for 55 years
en.dek: A ground-floor unit on Arbuthnot Road changed hands last month for 21.4 million dollars, the Post reported.

zh.headline: 協成行沽出持有55年中環地舖
zh.dek: 《南華早報》引土地註冊處資料稱，亞畢諾道地舖上月底以2140萬元易手。

en.headline: Salt-water pipe burst floods Kwai Fong motorcycle bays
en.dek: Muddy water soaked parked bikes on Wing Fong Road on Wednesday night after a short supply cut.

zh.headline: 葵芳榮芳路鹹水管爆裂 電單車泊位湧黃泥水
zh.dek: 周三約晚上10時盛芳街一帶地底鹹水管爆裂，水務署暫停供應約32分鐘。

en.headline: Heath opens a public-regret show in Chungking Mansions
en.dek: What We Regret Most, built from about 40 public submissions, runs in Tsim Sha Tsui until 27 October.

zh.headline: 重慶大廈Heath展出公眾「最後悔」故事
zh.dek: 展覽《What We Regret Most》周四晚開幕，展至10月27日，約有40件公眾投稿。

en.headline: Police arrest man, 41, after failed breath test in San Po Kong
en.dek: Officers stopped an unsteady private car near Choi Hung Road late on Wednesday and bailed the driver.

zh.headline: 新蒲崗私家車行車不穩 41歲司機酒測不合格被捕
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部周三深夜在彩虹道路障截停一輛自訂車牌私家車，司機保釋候查。

en.headline: Police arrest five in Kwun Tong fishing-machine raid
en.dek: Officers seized four fishing-game machines, game cards and 1,300 dollars in cash from a Shing Yip Street flat in an early-Friday raid.

zh.headline: 觀塘成業街搗破釣魚機賭檔 五人被捕
zh.dek: 觀塘警區人員周五凌晨突擊搜查成業街一個單位，檢獲四部釣魚機、一批遊戲卡及1300元現金，兩男三女涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博被捕。

en.headline: Film Archive screens Cheng Pei-pei tribute this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Film Archive shows a Mandarin feature at 11am on Friday, with a Cantonese talk afterwards, in a series remembering Cheng Pei-pei.

zh.headline: 電影資料館今早放映鄭佩佩紀念場
zh.dek: 香港電影資料館周五上午11時放映《蘭嶼之歌》，國語對白、中英文字幕，映後設粵語講談，屬紀念鄭佩佩的影畫早晨系列。

en.headline: Police arrest man over fatal Route Twisk crash
en.dek: Officers held a 36-year-old man at the airport on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death, after a motorcyclist died following a Route Twisk collision.

zh.headline: 荃錦公路致命車禍 警方機場拘捕36歲男子
zh.dek: 八鄉荃錦公路周三晚發生致命交通意外，電單車司機送院後不治。警方周四下午在機場拘捕一名36歲非華裔男子，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人死亡。

en.headline: Taxi driver arrested after man struck in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A man was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital with facial injuries after a taxi hit him near Sham Shui Po Park early on Friday.

zh.headline: 深水埗的士撞倒過路男子 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周五凌晨通州街近深水埗公園有的士撞倒一名男子，傷者面部受傷送瑪嘉烈醫院，司機涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。

en.headline: Government rejects US trafficking report on Hong Kong
en.dek: A spokesman called Hong Kong's Tier 3 ranking in the 2026 US Trafficking in Persons Report unfounded, and said screening last year identified 15 victims.

zh.headline: 政府反對美國販運人口報告對港評級
zh.dek: 發言人指《2026年美國販運人口報告》把香港列為第三級別毫無根據，並稱去年約12100次初步識別審核中識別15名受害者。

en.headline: MegaBox screens NBA China Games from its Kowloon Bay roof
en.dek: The mall will show the Mavericks against the Rockets at Mega Sky on Friday night and again on Sunday afternoon.

zh.headline: 九龍灣MegaBox天台直播觀賞NBA中國賽
zh.dek: 商場表示，周五晚上及周日下午於十八樓Mega Sky轉播獨行俠對火箭，入場券須於地下禮賓部換領。

en.headline: Police College to offer funded honours degree for junior officers
en.dek: The force says a new applied degree in security and criminal investigation will recruit later this year and start classes in March.

zh.headline: 警察學院開辦員佐級榮譽學士課程 學費由警隊全額資助
zh.dek: 警方表示，安保及刑事調查應用學位課程年底招生，明年三月開課，對象為未持學士學位的員佐級人員。

en.headline: Justice Department seeks review of Queen Mary lift sentence
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said a review has been filed after a registered engineer was given community service.

zh.headline: 律政司就瑪麗醫院升降機案刑罰提出覆核
zh.dek: 機電工程署表示，涉案註冊工程師被判社會服務令後，律政司已根據《裁判官條例》提出覆核，其升降機及自動梯註冊資格亦已撤銷。

en.headline: Police arrest five over copper taken from closed Shek Lei Pui plant
en.dek: Officers detained four men on suspicion of burglary and a recycling-shop operator over parts valued at about 350,000 dollars.

zh.headline: 石梨貝濾水廠銅件被盜 警拘五人包括回收店負責人
zh.dek: 警方指，已停用的金山石梨貝濾水廠銅線及四十八個銅製水泵部件被盜，損失約三十五萬元，供水未受影響。

en.headline: Hannah Pong opens first solo show at PMQ
en.dek: A free body-art exhibition by Hong Kong artist Hannah Pong runs at PMQ unit H303 from 9 to 17 October.

zh.headline: 龐學文首個個展今起在元創方展出
zh.dek: 人體藝術家龐學文的免費個展於元創方H303舉行，展期由10月9日至17日。

en.headline: Gelato market returns to PMQ for a second weekend
en.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest opens again at PMQ in Central from Friday to Sunday, with free entry and stalls from 20 makers.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集今起再登陸中環元創方
zh.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest 周五至周日在元創方地下舉行，入場免費，約20個品牌設檔。

en.headline: Cheung sues Hui for 10.1 billion dollars in High Court
en.dek: A writ seen by local media says Francis Cheung claims Xu Jiayin confirmed an unpaid balance in November 2022 and has not repaid it.

zh.headline: 張松橋入稟高院追討許家印101億元
zh.dek: 本地傳媒引述入稟狀指，許家印2022年11月書面確認尚欠101億元，惟未有償還。

en.headline: Election Committee takes 164 more forms on second day
en.dek: Returning officers received 160 candidate forms and four designated-body forms on Thursday, taking the two-day total to 471.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉次日再收164份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任星期四接獲160份候選人提名及4份指定團體提名，兩日累計471份。

en.headline: Parents in Tuen Mun neglect case released on bail
en.dek: Police said the pair must report back later this month. Social workers have taken three children to hospital for assessment.

zh.headline: 屯門富泰邨涉虐兒父母獲准保釋
zh.dek: 警方表示兩人須於本月下旬報到。社署已安排三名子女到醫院接受健康評估。

en.headline: Housing Bureau says Anderson delay will not hit supply
en.dek: The bureau said progress on one project would not materially affect overall flat supply, and it would press the developer to finish units safely.

zh.headline: 房屋局：安達臣道進度不影響整體供應
zh.dek: 局方指個別項目進度不會對整體房屋供應構成重大影響，並會督促發展商在安全前提下早日完工。

en.headline: Taxi driver jailed six weeks over North Point crash
en.dek: A 79-year-old driver admitted dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after a February collision on Java Road. He was also banned for two years.

zh.headline: 北角的士司機認危駕判囚六星期
zh.dek: 79歲司機承認今年2月在渣華道危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害，另被停牌兩年。

en.headline: Lam says Justice Bureau will study who pays if AI causes harm
en.dek: The secretary for justice told LegCo a task force will look at liability when an AI product causes damage, alongside guidance for minors.

zh.headline: 林定國：律政司將研究人工智能產品造成損害的法律責任
zh.dek: 律政司司長在立法會表示，會牽頭成立專責小組，並指針對未成年人的指引同樣重要。

en.headline: CK Asset to demolish three Anderson Road towers
en.dek: The Buildings Department has approved plans to take down three of six towers after steel bars departed from the approved drawings.

zh.headline: 長實安達臣道三座大樓拆卸重建 屋宇署已批圖則
zh.dek: 屋宇署接納其中三幢補救方案，餘下三幢的拆卸圖則已獲批准，但尚未收到展開拆卸的申請。

en.headline: Housing institute calls for a statutory building upkeep fund
en.dek: The Hong Kong Institute of Housing says owners should pay into a separate maintenance account as more than 24,000 buildings turn 50 by 2043.

zh.headline: 房屋經理學會促設立法定大廈維修基金
zh.dek: 學會指業主應定期向獨立帳戶供款，以應付2043年前逾2.4萬幢樓齡達50年的維修壓力。

en.headline: ICAC charges man, 80, over alleged 10,000 dollar bribe offer
en.dek: Prosecutors say he offered cash to a Yau Tsim Mong councillor to press a pastor into a meeting. He is due in court on Friday.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴八旬翁涉向區議員提供一萬元利益
zh.dek: 控方指他向油尖旺區議員提供現金，意圖促成與一名牧師會面。案件星期五在西九龍裁判法院答辯。

en.headline: Silver Bond due 2027 to pay 4 per cent on fourth coupon
en.dek: The HKMA set the rate at the 4 per cent fixed floor after the inflation-linked floating rate came in at 1.80 per cent.

zh.headline: 2027年到期銀債第四次付息年利率定為4厘
zh.dek: 金管局公布浮息為1.80厘，低於4厘定息，故今次按較高的定息支付，付息日為10月23日。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes 344 points lower at a three-month low
en.dek: The index finished at 23,785 after a second straight fall, with financial and AI-related shares leading the decline.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌344點 創三個月低位
zh.dek: 指數收報23785點，連跌兩日，金融股及人工智能相關股份領跌。

en.headline: Police arrest 10 over fake model ads used to open mule accounts
en.dek: Officers say a syndicate used job ads to control e-wallet accounts linked to 43 deception cases.

zh.headline: 假模特兒招聘誘開傀儡戶口 警拘10人
zh.dek: 警方指集團以招聘廣告操控電子錢包，涉及43宗騙案。

en.headline: Chan says ride-hailing data system has entered testing
en.dek: The transport chief said the system is largely complete, as nine autonomous-vehicle pilot licences are already issued.

zh.headline: 陳美寶：網約車數據系統已進入測試
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長說系統已基本完成，運輸署並已批出九個自動駕駛先導牌照。

en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Route Twisk collision, police say
en.dek: A 35-year-old rider died after a light goods vehicle left the scene in Pat Heung on Wednesday night.

zh.headline: 荃錦公路電單車司機送院後不治
zh.dek: 八鄉昨晚一輛輕型貨車疑以倒後鏡撞到電單車後駛離，35歲司機延至凌晨不治。

en.headline: AFCD starts four-month sweep for unattended dogs
en.dek: The department said it will first go to places with previous attacks or gatherings of stray dogs.

zh.headline: 漁護署展開四個月捕捉無人看管狗隻行動
zh.dek: 署方說會優先到曾有狗隻襲擊途人，或有流浪狗聚集的地點執法。

en.headline: Police recover gold swapped for fabric softener in Kwun Tong hotel
en.dek: Officers say about 30 kilograms of gold grains, valued at 30 million dollars, were taken from a hotel room and later found in Tai Po.

zh.headline: 觀塘酒店金粒被掉包成柔順劑 警拘兩男起回失金
zh.dek: 警方表示，約30公斤、值約3000萬元的金粒在酒店房間被偷走，其後在大埔賓館起回，兩名持雙程證男子被扣查。

en.headline: Lawmakers press Northern Metropolis university town in LegCo debate
en.dek: On the second day of the joint debate, Andrew Yao called the university town the main course of the Northern Metropolis, while Ng Wing-ka urged infrastructure first.

zh.headline: 立法會辯北都 姚祖輝稱大學城如主菜
zh.dek: 五年規劃與施政報告合併辯論進入北部都會區一節，姚祖輝聚焦大學城，吳永嘉則倡基建先行。

en.headline: National security police bail man and woman over social posts
en.dek: Officers arrested the pair, both 38, in Kwun Tong and Tsim Sha Tsui on Tuesday over an alleged sedition offence, and released them on bail.

zh.headline: 國安處拘一男一女涉社交平台帖文 兩人保釋候查
zh.dek: 警方周二在觀塘及尖沙咀拘捕兩名38歲男女，涉嫌《維護國家安全條例》第24條，兩人已獲准保釋。

en.headline: Victoria Park stall 1 lets for 34,000 dollars, down on last year
en.dek: Now News said the large dry-goods pitch that fetched about 50,000 dollars last year went for 34,000 dollars on the second auction day.

zh.headline: 維園年宵1號乾貨檔以3.4萬元成交 低過去年
zh.dek: Now新聞報道，去年以約5萬元投得的大型乾貨1號檔，周四以3.4萬元由同一人再投得。

en.headline: Police hold woman, 22, over fake official deposit scam
en.dek: Officers say she showed a fake police warrant card and is linked to eight cases, after one victim transferred nearly 650,000 dollars.

zh.headline: 假扮入境處及公安收保證金 22歲女被捕
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組表示，女子涉嫌出示偽造警察委任證，涉及8宗案件，其中一宗事主轉帳近65萬元。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 24,000 at the Thursday midday close
en.dek: The index was down 167 points at 23,963 by midday, according to RTHK, with turnover above 100 billion dollars.

zh.headline: 恒指半日失守24000點 跌167點
zh.dek: 港台報道，恒指午市報23963點，跌167點，跌幅約百分之0.7，半日成交逾1000億元。

en.headline: Hong Kong rise three places to 153rd in FIFA ranking
en.dek: The latest men's ranking, published on 7 October, puts Hong Kong on 1,035.23 points after a gain credited to the match against Cambodia.

zh.headline: FIFA排名港隊升3位至第153
zh.dek: 國際足協7日公布最新男足排名，港隊積1035.23分，上升得益於對柬埔寨一仗，港台周四報道有關排名。

en.headline: Reports say police arrest man, 66, over Sau Mau Ping paint attack
en.dek: Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao, citing sources, say a 66-year-old estate resident was held over red paint thrown at two lawmakers' joint office.

zh.headline: 消息指秀茂坪淋紅油案 警方拘捕66歲男子
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島引述消息稱，一名66歲邨內居民涉向兩名議員聯合辦事處淋紅油，已被拘捕，案件列刑事毀壞。

en.headline: Mainland arrivals pass golden week forecast in six days
en.dek: Immigration Department figures put mainland visitor arrivals at 1.3 million in the first six days, above the 1.29 million forecast for the full holiday.

zh.headline: 內地訪港六日已超黃金周預測
zh.dek: 入境處數字顯示，國慶假期首六日內地旅客達一百三十萬人次，高於整周一百二十九萬的預測，按年升百分之十一點六。

en.headline: Cross-boundary operator proposes lower Huanggang senior fares
en.dek: Eternal East Bus wants elderly and disabled fares on its Huanggang routes cut toward franchised-bus levels, and hopes to join the two-dollar scheme.

zh.headline: 跨境巴士擬減皇崗長者車費
zh.dek: 永東直巴希望把來往皇崗的長者及殘疾人士車費減至與專營巴士相若，並爭取納入兩元乘車優惠。

en.headline: Trade council's 60th-anniversary show runs at Times Square
en.dek: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council exhibition in Causeway Bay is open daily until 14 October, with a companion artwork at a Wan Chai tram stop.

zh.headline: 貿發局六十周年展覽銅鑼灣展出
zh.dek: 展覽在時代廣場地面有蓋廣場舉行，每日開放至十月十四日；灣仔柯布連道電車站另有主題畫作，展至十月二十九日。

en.headline: David Silva comes out of retirement to join Supreme Sha Tin
en.dek: The former Spain and Manchester City midfielder, 40, is expected in Hong Kong soon for a fitness check before training with the Premier League club.

zh.headline: 施華四十歲復出 加盟港超球會沙田
zh.dek: 前西班牙及曼城中場施華將抵港接受體能評估，再與球隊訓練，沙田下一仗於十月十八日對香港足球會。

en.headline: Police hold helper after report of assault on boy, 5
en.dek: A 37-year-old domestic helper was arrested in Kowloon City after a mother reported that her son had been hit at their Hau Wong Road home.

zh.headline: 九龍城5歲男童疑遭外傭襲擊 37歲菲傭被捕
zh.dek: 一名母親周三晚報案，指5歲兒子在侯王道住所疑被外傭不當對待，警方以涉嫌虐待受看管兒童拘捕37歲菲傭。

en.headline: Anderson's first mall opens in stages before 13 October
en.dek: Link says Link Square in the Anderson Road Quarry development is in soft opening, with a formal launch set for 13 October.

zh.headline: 安達臣首個商場領達廣場分階段啟用 13日正式開幕
zh.dek: 領展表示，觀塘安達臣道石礦場發展區的領達廣場已於10月6日起試業，正式開幕訂於10月13日。

en.headline: Police investigate red-paint attack on Sau Mau Ping offices
en.dek: Officers were called at 6:40am after red paint was thrown at a joint district office used by two lawmakers in Sau Mau Ping Estate.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪議員聯合辦事處遭淋紅油 警列刑事毀壞
zh.dek: 警方今早約6時40分接報，秀茂坪邨秀緻樓地下鄧家彪與陳沛良的聯合地區辦事處被淋紅油，鐵閘及告示板均沾污。

en.headline: SFC sets November start for retail fund code changes
en.dek: The securities watchdog will bring in a value-at-risk method for derivatives exposure and tighter liquidity rules for authorised retail funds.

zh.headline: 證監會零售基金守則修訂十一月生效
zh.dek: 證監會公布諮詢總結，單位信託及互惠基金守則將引入風險價值計算法管理衍生工具風險，並加強流動性及貨幣市場基金保障。
